bboxNote: GREATER Dnipro ~20 x 20 km (~10 km radius from the city centre 48.46/35.05) — widened 2026-07-14 (owner ask) from the full-city ~7.4x8.9 km box. grid 10->20 keeps cell size ~1.0x1.0 km (streaming granularity + within-cell relief limit unchanged). bbox = [west,south,east,north] deg. ENRICHED.bbox in src/components/globe/tuning.ts MUST match this (mask extent == enriched extent, or they overlap/gap). Re-bake BOTH variants on change (bake.mjs + bake-osm2world.mjs — dnipro-o2w extends this file).

buildings.skirtNote: RC13 base skirt (m) — read by BOTH bakers (bake-osm2world.mjs inherits this block through `extends`). Walls start this far below the feature's base so residual sink/float after the group/cell/footprint re-seat ladder never shows sky under a building. It LOWERS the existing bottom rim rather than appending a course of quads: +0 vertices, against the measured +59 % an appended skirt costs on the OSM2World soup (audit S13 caps growth at +10 %). Guards and the full rationale: scripts/bake/lib/buildings.mjs. Set 0 to bake without it.

vegetation.vegetationNote: Slice 3 trees: OSM natural=tree points (Dnipro maps only ~418) + tree_row sampling + seeded scatter over natural=wood / landuse=forest / leisure=park polygons (grass is NOT planted). Deterministic; heights are class defaults + jitter — the ETH/Meta canopy-height raster is the documented upgrade tier (README §Upgrade tiers).
vegetation.maxTreesNote: 60000 sufficed for the 7.4x8.9 km box (hit 24,714); the 20x20 km box adds the big left-bank/Samara forests and the cap thins HASH-UNIFORMLY across the whole box — a low cap would visibly thin the in-city parks too. 200000 keeps in-city density; instanced trees cost ~50 B each baked.

exclusion.polygonsNote: C6: per-site military/critical-infra exclusion polygons ([lon,lat] rings). Empty for v1 — the built-in sensitive-tag blocklist (scripts/bake/lib/exclusion.mjs DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_TAGS) still applies. Add named-site rings here as they are identified from PUBLIC pre-war sources only.

terrain.terrainNote: GLO-30 quantized-mesh patch (design ruling 2026-08-18): extentBbox = whole input 1x1-deg GLO-30 tiles (served fully-inside up to extentMaxDepth, rim-blended to CWT over blendKm at the edge — blend.mjs, post-bake); cityBbox = the enriched bbox above (deep-detail area above extentMaxDepth — MUST stay equal to bbox, same mask-extent coupling). L13 64-seg posting is 38x25 m ~ GLO-30 native; L14 resolves the 20.5 m E-W arcsec detail city-only (mago may cap below — the bake warns and patch-info.json carries the real max). Heights become ELLIPSOIDAL via mago's built-in EGM2008 geoid (--geoid EGM2008) — same datum as CWT, so runtime seating needs no datum handling; geoid.mjs is the verification twin. C6: 30 m native = SRTM-class public data (owner ruling 2026-08-18); never bake finer without an explicit ruling. Runtime twin: src/lib/globe/regions.ts terrain block MUST match the bake console snippet.
terrain.maxDepthNote: mago 1.14.2 silently clamps maxDepth to its raster-resolution heuristic — 13 for 30 m input (asked 14, got 13; ruling 2026-08-18: ship 13 — 64-seg L13 posting 38x25 m ~ GLO-30 native 31x21 m, the L14 gain was marginal). extentMaxDepth == maxDepth ⇒ the city deep-detail clause is dormant until a finer source ever lands.
